notes: Base KH 120 II model (non-AES67). A separate variant "KH 120 II AES67" adds redundant AES67/RAVENNA/ST 2110 network audio ports (not modeled here). No bandwidth grade is stated for the RJ45 control port (MA 1 software uses standard IP data; speed unspecified), so grade omitted per instructions. AC inlet type confirmed as IEC (C14) via manual references; exact C13/C14 designation not explicitly stated on manufacturer spec page but matches standard IEC inlet convention for this class of monitor. Desktop/stand-mount nearfield monitor - not rack-mountable (rackUnits omitted). Dimensions 287x182x227mm, 5.4kg, power 15W idle/320W peak/0.3W standby.

ports.name: Analog In
ports.note: Electronically balanced analog audio input, 24 kOhm impedance

ports.name: S/PDIF In
ports.note: 75 ohm digital S/PDIF input, for daisy-chaining monitors

ports.name: S/PDIF Out
ports.note: 75 ohm digital S/PDIF output (loop-through of S/PDIF In or converted Analog In)

ports.name: Network
ports.note: Control/remote port for MA 1 monitor alignment software (standard IP data); speed not published, not present on non-networked... actually present on all KH 120 II

ports.name: AC In
ports.note: IEC C14 inlet, universal power supply 100-240V~, mains switch
